neighbours.label: Python: the line break right after an assignment that joins two values with '+' (s = a + b), i.e. the end of a concatenation statement; top examples also include final pieces of split compounds (windch|ill, hydr|ate)

notes: Card: ' +' x3, " '" x2, ')' x2 in string-concatenation code, top example is the newline after 's = string1 + string1'; the rest are word-final fragments (al|ge|bras, hydr|ate, windch|ill). Probes: "message = 'Hello, ' + name" 0.38 and 't = s + s' 0.28 (both on the newline), windchill 0.34, hydrate 0.29; 'w * h' 0.03, one-line print with + 0.01.
